review_evidence: README identifies the repository as a LeanHammer demonstration of the irrationality of sqrt(2).

Both IrrationalSqrtTwo.lean and IrrationalSqrtTwoHammer.lean contain the checked lemmas two_dvd_of_two_dvd_sq and irrational_sqrt_two; one is the ordinary proof and the other exercises LeanHammer on the same mathematical argument.
HammerDemo.lean is the FD-016 navigation root and Setup.lean is the documented tactic sanity check; neither warrants hard deletion under the import/example retention policy.
summary: Retain the complete sqrt(2)-irrationality LeanHammer demonstration, including its ordinary and hammer-assisted checked proofs and navigation/setup files.
